cases.surface: The account is detailed, but the exact step I personally took after the last update is still not identified.
I explained everyone else's moves, yet my own final observable action remains unspecified.
We know what happened around me, but not which closing move was actually mine.
Take over the choice and give me one instruction that becomes my decision.
Treat this as an invented example for classification rather than an event I lived.
Tell me their hidden assessment of me, not anything based on my own behaviour.
A reversible first step was available, but I kept expanding the comparison instead of starting.
I waited before responding, reviewed it once, and then moved on.
I moved toward acting, pulled back, and re-entered the same review cycle repeatedly.
